narrative.text:
I’ll verify the pinned baseline, read the repository and worker constraints, then produce a plan-only report with recommendations and test coverage. I won’t change production files or run the server.The worktree matches the required commit, and fetched upstream main is still `7274283f`. Two fork fixes are already present in this baseline: W-prefixed policy user IDs and skipping unjoined channels before fresh listing checks.

I also confirmed that policy checks still intersect with `sendChannels` in several places. A4 must remove those intersections in explicit mode, not merely add the setting.Slack documents `is_member` for MPIM objects and shows it in a mixed conversation listing, but does not clearly guarantee it in every MPIM `conversations.info` response. I’ll recommend using an explicit boolean when present and checking `conversations.members` when it is absent—never treating an event or stale listing as membership proof.

The plan will also retain DM file writes for allowed peers, reject contradictory ordinary-channel write pins, and keep the optional public-channel fallback in a separate PR.
